compactRecord.rs: Late Apr–early May the moats glow pink – climb the 107 m Goryōkaku Tower for the textbook star aerial. Free park; tower ¥1000.
compactRecord.td: Star-shaped Vauban-style fort built 1857–66 by Takeda Ayasaburō; HQ of the breakaway Republic of Ezo and stage of the Boshin War's last battle (1869). Now a Special Historic Site with ~1,600 cherry trees and a reconstructed magistrate's office.
